confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional price levels, not live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by neighborhood and season. Cocktail and wine are based on their usual premium over domestic beer. FX came from an rba.gov.au homepage snippet with jumbled labels, and a third-party aggregator showed 0.6947 for 2026-10-16, so verify against the F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Mexican cities outside major tourist hubs, priced somewhat below central-Mexico tourist towns and well below Mexico City. No single named comparable city was used.
